content: Auth for write endpoints: FastAPI security.APIKeyHeader(name=X-API-Key) is the canonical light pattern for self-hosted (Security() dependency registers OpenAPI scheme; auto_error=False to distinguish 401 missing vs 403 invalid). Header beats query param (keys leak into URL logs). Alternatives: HTTPBearer (Authorization: Bearer) equally fine, standard. Static single key is sufficient for single-user self-hosted; per-client keys only when multiple callers need revocation/traceability. Rules: never hardcode key or default-fallback env value; load from env/file outside repo, fail fast at startup if missing; >=32 char random; combine with rate limiting for expensive POSTs; protect all state-changing routes, leave health GETs public. gogo precedent: tokens already stored gitignored in data/*.txt read via env-first - same pattern fits.
